title: Tractor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#2a3a4a' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- rear wheel (left, large) -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='73' r='18' fill='#3a5a7a'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='73' r='14' fill='#5080b0'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='73' r='8' fill='#e8c840'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='73' r='3' fill='#ff8040'/>
  <!-- wheel treads -->
  <rect x='25' y='54' width='6' height='6' rx='1' fill='#2a4a6a'/>
  <rect x='25' y='86' width='6' height='6' rx='1' fill='#2a4a6a'/>
  <rect x='9' y='70' width='6' height='6' rx='1' fill='#2a4a6a'/>
  <rect x='41' y='70' width='6' height='6' rx='1' fill='#2a4a6a'/>

  <!-- front wheel (right, small) -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='13' fill='#3a5a7a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='9' fill='#5080b0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='5' fill='#e8c840'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='2' fill='#ff8040'/>
  <rect x='69' y='64' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#2a4a6a'/>
  <rect x='69' y='87' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#2a4a6a'/>

  <!-- tractor body -->
  <rect x='22' y='50' width='58' height='22' rx='4' fill='#e84040'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x='22' y='50' width='58' height='5' rx='3' fill='#ff6666'/>
  
  <!-- engine hood -->
  <rect x='52' y='42' width='30' height='14' rx='3' fill='#d03030'/>
  <rect x='52' y='42' width='30' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff6666'/>
  
  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x='58' y='30' width='4' height='14' rx='1' fill='#808080'/>
  <rect x='57' y='28' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a0a0a0'/>
  
  <!-- exhaust puff -->
  <circle cx='59' cy='24' r='3' fill='#c0c0d0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='19' r='2.5' fill='#c0c0d0' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- cab -->
  <rect x='24' y='28' width='24' height='24' rx='3' fill='#f0a020'/>
  <rect x='24' y='28' width='24' height='5' rx='3' fill='#ffc040'/>
  <!-- cab window -->
  <rect x='28' y='33' width='16' height='14' rx='2' fill='#60b0d0'/>
  <!-- window shine -->
  <rect x='30' y='35' width='5' height='10' rx='1' fill='#90d0e8' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- cab roof -->
  <rect x='22' y='25' width='28' height='5' rx='2' fill='#ffc040'/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='48' r='4' fill='#ffff80'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='48' r='2' fill='#ffffd0'/>
  
  <!-- fender over rear wheel -->
  <path d='M10 65 Q10 52 28 52 Q46 52 46 65' fill='none' stroke='#c03030' stroke-width='3'/>
  
  <!-- front grill -->
  <rect x='76' y='45' width='4' height='14' rx='1' fill='#a0a0a0'/>
  <line x1='77' y1='48' x2='79' y2='48' stroke='#d0d0d0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='77' y1='51' x2='79' y2='51' stroke='#d0d0d0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='77' y1='54' x2='79' y2='54' stroke='#d0d0d0' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
